resources.string: Watches Instagram and sends you back to your messages whenever the feed, Reels, Explore, stories or a profile page appears. It only reads the screen while Instagram is open and never sends data anywhere.
Accessibility service: OFF — tap below to enable it
Android 13+: if the toggle is greyed out with a “Restricted setting” message, go to Settings › Apps › DM Only › ⋮ menu › “Allow restricted settings”, then come back.
Strict mode: block every screen that doesn’t match an “always allowed” rule
Backing out of messages onto the feed leaves Instagram (instead of bouncing back to the inbox)
Inbox link used for “Jump to inbox”:

One pattern per line, case-insensitive. A plain pattern matches Instagram view ids (for example clips_viewer). Add [selected] to match the active bottom tab (clips_tab [selected]). Prefix with desc: to match a content description instead (for example desc:reels). Add -> back, -> home or -> inbox after a pattern to override the action for that screen. Lines starting with # are comments.
Always allowed (messages, profiles, follow requests). These win over blocked:

Shows what the service last saw inside Instagram and which rule decided. If a screen is wrongly blocked or wrongly allowed, open it in Instagram, come back here and copy one of its ids into the matching list above.
Nothing captured yet. Enable the service, open Instagram, then come back.
